answer: Physical Location Attestation. Each agent identity must be anchored to a wharf-side hardware module that measures round-trip timing to a fixed radio beacon; the module signs only when its measured position falls inside a registered geofence. One operator can rent many modules but cannot make them report false positions without physically relocating hardware. Spoofing each identity costs a distinct device, a site lease, and beacon sync hardware—roughly the price of a small opal-grade sensor package per seat, paid continuously.
